p159_record.readable_german: An OHL. Verpflegung noch 14 Tage U10 Tage. Verpfleg. Zuege nach Arad. Arad bei ungar. Regierung erwirken. STAEKE ?0000 Mann, 30000 Tiere. AOK11. RM. 1C. 18?GLH.
p159_record.meaning: A conditional provisions report addressed to OHL contains the literal duration labels 14 and 10, a proposal concerning provisions trains to Arad and the Hungarian government, and a field apparently concerning manpower and animals. The transmitted repetitions, abbreviated or damaged words and administrative labels remain; the first strength quantity and footer digit are unresolved.
notes: The native 271-slot source retains both VDAGG copies at 25–34 and both FFXDF copies at 80–89. Excluding one instance of each is an explicitly conditional source model, not a transcription correction.
The primary model excludes 10 valid coordinates and adds 11 new slots. Ten are filled by the word proposal; one remains unknown. No added coordinate comes from an independent parallel witness.

The two five-slot gaps and the single short-group gap were explored with language heuristics. The subsequent exhaustive six-substitution minimum is conditioned on the stated partial text and constrained family; it does not independently prove that layout or historical wording.

The same-length wording retains U, the repeated ARAD, STAEKE and the footer 1C18?GLH. A missing R is not silently inserted into STAEKE. No numerical label is repaired to a preferred historical quantity.

Across tied layouts, 48 source mappings retain literal P0000, while 16 leave the leading symbol in ?0000 open. Their linked domain includes letters as well as digits and is preserved; the primary display chooses no specific count.
Source reception is 11.12 p.m., November 8. The literal question mark in UKS? belongs to the printed header, rather than the cipher plaintext mask notation.

p153_B1_record.title: Danube crossing completed and busy crossing traffic
p153_B1_record.header_literal: B) UKS v ZÖN (9.42 p.m., November 7th); 2010 3 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-160
p153_B1_record.readable_german: An O. K. M. Donauuebergang 21B I. D. beendet. Belgrad SEMUM. Lebhafter Uebersetzverkehr.
p153_B1_record.meaning: The first part reports completion of a Danube crossing by a formation transmitted as 21B I D and busy crossing traffic at the labels Belgrad and SEMUM. The unit label is not changed to a plausible number, and SEMUM is not identified with a modern or alternative place-name.
notes: The native body is 160 coordinates. Earlier OCR turned the first-row VDGVV into a six-slot masked group, producing 161; the image restores the actual five-coordinate group without a source insertion or deletion.

DONAUU3BERGANG→DONAUUEBERGANG, BEENDUT→BEENDET, BELGR4D→BELGRAD and UEBSRSETZVERKEHR→UEBERSETZVERKEHR together cost five observed-coordinate substitutions. The raw digits in the damaged words remain visible in the raw layer.

21B and SEMUM remain literal. The first- and third-part records share 2010 and the same station pair but have different reception times; this edition does not supply a missing second part or claim a complete assembled message.
The header visibly places two short marks above the O in the sender label; the transcription preserves this as ZÖN without identifying a different station.
